title: Revisiting Superlinear Convergence of Proximal Newton-Like Methods to Degenerate Solutions
summary: We describe inexact proximal Newton-like methods for solving degenerate regularized optimization problems and for the broader problem of finding a zero of a generalized equation that is the sum of a continuous map and a maximal monotone operator. Superlinear convergence for both the distance to the solution set and a certain measure of first-order optimality can be achieved under a Hölderian error bound condition, including for problems in which the continuous map is nonmonotone, with Jacobian singular at the solution and not Lipschitz.
